title: DC Challenge #6 1986 Batman Adam Strange Dr Fate Dan Jurgens Cover Maxi-Series
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear; small edge wear at the lower right. See photos.
descriptionText:
DC Challenge! #6 (April 1986), DC Comics - 12-part maxi-series, Chapter Six by Elliot S! Maggin, Dan Jurgens and Larry Mahlstedt. Batman, Adam Strange, Doctor Fate and Hawkman on the cover. $1.25 cover price.

Back cover: Monogram Lightning RC racer ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear and small edge wear at the lower right (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
